title: Musk says Tesla's mega AI chip fab project to launch in seven days
title_zh: 马斯克称特斯拉大型人工智能芯片工厂项目将于 7 天内启动
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday that the company's Terafab project to make artificial ‌intelligence chips will launch in seven days. Musk had said ‌last year that Tesla probably will have to build "a gigantic chip fab" ​to make artificial intelligence chips.
summary_zh: 特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 周六表示，该公司制造人工智能芯片的 Terafab 项目将于 7 天内启动。马斯克去年曾表示，特斯拉可能必须建造“一座巨大的芯片工厂”来生产人工智能芯片。

title: Rivian's base R2 starts at $45K but won't be available until late 2027
title_zh: Rivian 的基础版 R2 起价为 4.5 万美元，但要到 2027 年底才会上市
summary: Rivian revealed trim levels and pricing on Thursday for its highly anticipated R2 midsize electric SUV, but the version with Tesla Model Y-killer pricing won't be coming this year.
summary_zh: Rivian 周四公布了其备受期待的 R2 中型电动 SUV 的内饰水平和定价，但具有特斯拉 Model Y 杀手级定价的版本今年不会推出。

title: It takes more than Nvidia's chips to build the world's data centers
title_zh: 构建全球数据中心需要的不仅仅是 Nvidia 的芯片
summary: Nvidia is winning the AI race thanks to its chips, but it needs partners to build the data centers that use them.
summary_zh: 英伟达凭借其芯片赢得了人工智能竞赛，但它需要合作伙伴来构建使用这些芯片的数据中心。
